Name: Camelus - Camel Expansion
Author: ZoeyHoshi
Description:
[center]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/0a8S6ot.png[/img]﻿[/center]

Camels are one of the longest domesticated farm animals in the world, and now they can do even more here. Originally this was supposed to be a retexture of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]'s Camel, however then I wanted to add a baby texture... Then I got more and more ideas so this became a full expansion on SVE's camels.

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/mDd4MPK.png[/img][/center]
[u][b]New Textures for Camels[/b][/u]
This is what started this whole overhaul mod, SVE's camels now have a brand new look. Based on the Dromedary camel, also known as the Arabian Camel. While they aren't the ones with the camel hair that is used in textiles, they're the ones used in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url].

[u][b]Baby Camels & Pregnancy[/b][/u]
Camels now have a baby stage instead of being bought as adults, so you can find baby camels tailing after any adults. Along with this camels can now be pregnant and give birth like other farm animals.

[b][u]Shave Your Camel's Hair, Not Wool[/u][/b]
No longer will camels drop Camel Wool on the floor of their barn, now they will get all fluffy and need to be shorn like sheep. Of course, if they are in the premium barn, you don't have to worry about that to begin with. Also, while it can be known as Camel Wool, this is a Dromedary Camel, not a Bactrian Camel, and they have different coats. Camel hair is the more common phrase, so Camel Wool and Yarn display names have been changed to reflect this. So it's now Camel Hair and Camel Hair Yarn.

[u][b]New Sounds[/b][/u]
Camels no longer use the vanilla's game sound effects, with realistic sounds and different sounds between babies and adults as well. Don't worry, I made sure not to pick any unpleasant sounding ones, because if you've never heard a camel before, particularly a male one, you'd rather not hear that in your game...

[u][b]Several Different Colour Mutations[/b][/u]
There's 10 different colour mutations that your camels can have, from Albino to Black to Piedbald. This also comes with the config option to allow Camel Hair and Camel Hair Yarn to have matching colours to the camel they're from so you can a whole range of colourful yarn.

[u][b]Camel Milk and Cheese[/b][/u]
Camels are now all female, so they can be milked thanks to Extra Animal Config. Camel milk can be used just like any other milk from the game, and of course when put into a cheese press you get Camel Cheese. In the config options, you can even use Large Camel Milk to make a big slab of Large Camel Cheese if you want.

[u][b]Void Camels[/b][/u]
Behind a special unlock condition, there's an additional special Camel variation. Void Camels! Like the Void Chickens, these camels have unique products that net a higher price than your usual camels however their Void Camel Milk and Void Camel Cheese shares the flaw of not being liked by many...

[u][b]NPC Gift Tastes[/b][/u]
Gift tastes have been done for the base game NPCs and Stardew Valley Expanded's NPCs

[b][u]Animal Husbandry Mod Compatibility[/u][/b]
Another product camels have been used for is it's meat of course, so if you like playing with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry Mod[/url], now you have Camel Meat. Along with the meat, Camels now have appropriate treats and when visiting the Desert Trader you can buy a Camel Steak recipe. These will only be available if you play with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry Mod[/url].

[u][b]ZH's Artisanal Goods Compatibility[/b][/u]
All items have a ZH's Artisanal Goods texture, along with different variations you can tweak to your like. Of course, if you rather stick with the vanilla game and vanilla SVE's look, you can simply disable these settings in the config.

[center]﻿[u][b]Check out the Guide in Articles to see full details on new items, recipes and how to unlock everything[/b][/u][/center]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/XJwNaUF.png[/img]﻿[/center][b][u]Disable New Camel Sounds[/u][/b]
Enable this to turn off the new camel sounds and return to the original sound from SVE.

[b][u]Disable Void Camels[/u][/b]
Enable this to remove all Void Camels and Void Camel products.

[b][u]Enable Matching Colour Items[/u] - [i]DISABLED BY DEFAULT[/i][/b]
If enabled, then Camel Hair and Camel Hair Yarn will match the colour of the camel it's from but please note that [i]each colour hair and yarn is it's own unique item[/i]. If disabled, there will be only one type of Camel Hair and Camel Hair Yarn, so no matter your camel's colour, it'll all be the same colour so if you don't want several different types of hair and yarn stacks, then keep this disabled.

[b][u]Artisan Goods Retain Quality[/u][/b] - Disabled by default
If enabled, then Camel Cheese and Camel Hair Yarn will retain the same quality as its ingredient.

[u][b]Large Milk Products[/b][/u]
Choose what you result you want from Large Camel Milk when it's put in the Cheese Press. 
[b]Large Cheese[/b] - Large Camel Milk makes Large Camel Cheese. [i]This is the default option[/i]. 
[b]Walk Of Life Compatibility[/b] - Large Camel Milk makes 2 regular Camel Cheese instead of Large Cheese just like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24355]Walk Of Life[/url]

[b][u]ZH's Artisanal Goods Settings[/u][/b]
Just like any of my other Artisanal Goods series, every object is configerable and able to be disabled if you rather the vanilla textures.


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/6PbYZXF.png[/img]
﻿[/center]There's still some more things I'd like to do with this mod, but they can come later on. I'm not sure whether all of these things will be added depends.

[list]
[*]Retexture for Desert Trader's camel
[*]More camel meat-based recipes for the AHM side
[*]Bactrian (Two humped) camels, perhaps they will give special camel hair to make them different
[*]More items to make from Camel Hair, like cloth or fabric on the loom
[*]Some unique gift dialogue for fun
[*]More gift tastes added for more npc mods (If you have an NPC and want this, just let me know)
[/list]




[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/sEdxu4v.png[/img]﻿[/center]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] along with all its, and this mod's, dependancies.
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for easy configurations
4. Download the main .zip file from this mod and install it
5. When starting the game for the first time since installing, use Generic Mod Config Menu to configure the mod to your liking

You're all done and ready to play
